Remember, if you attend the entire tour, you'll receive a **special prize**!

### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

**ESPAÑOL**
El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**English**
The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers.
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024.

Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024.

The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. # ¡Bienvenidos a Cube Central Yucatán 2024!

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

How to get to Venue: There are two entrances. If you entered through the doors with a sky bridge above, turn left to take elevators or turn left at the middle of the building to go upstairs.
If you entered through the side with a field, take the elevators at the end of the building on the right or turn right at the middle of the building to go upstairs.
Signs will be posted around the building for directions.

Competitors may bring at most two guests.

This competition is sponsored by the Pi Kappa Phi Ability Experience. The Ability Experience is the philanthropic initiative of the Pi Kappa Phi fraternity dedicated to aiding the 6.5 million citizens living with disabilities across the United States. Together, we’re helping to change the way society views people with disabilities because labels should not define us. We put our values into action, bringing our mission for a more inclusive community to life every single day. 

For more information about the Ability Experience, please click on the Sponsors/Charity Info tab. All excess funds and donations from this competition will be donated to the Ability Experience.

items.information:
Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador.
​
Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador.
​
The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**


**Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only.

**Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.**

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

# **ESPAÑOL**

Te invitamos a una serie de mini competencias que se llevarán a cabo en San Luis Potosí, totalmente gratuitas. Estas competencias están diseñadas para ofrecer a los participantes una experiencia divertida y relajada, ideal tanto para principiantes como para aquellos que quieran mejorar sus habilidades. ¡No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte y disfrutar de esta emocionante serie de eventos!.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.


# **ENGLISH**

We invite you to a series of mini competitions that will take place in San Luis Potosí, completely free of charge. These competitions are designed to offer participants a fun and relaxed experience, ideal for beginners as well as those who want to improve their skills. Don’t miss the chance to join and enjoy this exciting series of events!
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.

### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다.
### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오.
### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.

### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist.
### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list.
### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement au-delà de la date de fin des inscriptions**. Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leur image soit utilisée par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et sur d'autres plateformes numériques.

***English version is below***

**Deutsch:**
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Autumn 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

**English:**
We are happy to announce the Vienna Autumn 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

venue.name: Kazakh Research Institute of Processing and Food Industry

items.information:
24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды.

Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды.

Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады.


24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников.

Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге.

Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM.


24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants.

The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge.

These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.information:
(SRB)

Belgrade Open 2024 je dvadeset i drugo po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. 

**Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koje discipline slažete. Ukoliko se takmičite samo u 3x3 i 2x2 kocki cena kotizacije iznosi 1,000RSD , ali ukoliko se takmičite u više disciplina plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.**

------------------------

(ENG)

Belgrade Open 2024 is the 22nd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition.

**Registration fee for this competition depends on which events you are competing in. If you are competing in only 3x3 and 2x2 cubes, you will pay 1,000RSD, but if you are competing in more events, you will pay the full amount of 2,000RSD. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Kyub sa Aga Masskara 2024
items.information:
**US (English)** 
The Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee is thrilled to present the **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** competition series, two competitions held in one day—morning and afternoon, in celebration of the Masskara Festival in Bacolod City!

This competition will be held in the morning, the afternoon competition can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024/register).

Competitors **shall only compete in one of the two competitions**, either [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) or [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). This is strictly implemented. We strongly encourage you to stay 'til the end of both competitions as there will be awards.

All events in both competitions are the same and will consist of a single round. For more details about the competition, please refer to the tabs above.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge and agree that the organizing bodies, their personnel, and any associated individuals shall not be held liable for any harm or injury, loss of personal belongings or property, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

***

**PH (Tagalog)**
Ikinagagalag na hinahandog ng Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** kompetisyong serye, dalawang kompetisyon na gaganapin sa isang araw—umaga at hapon, bilang pagdiriwang ng Masskara Festival sa Lungsod ng Bacolod!

Ang kompetisyong ito ay magaganap sa umaga. Ang hapong edisyon ay makikita [dito](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024).

Ang mga kalahok ay **dapat na makilahok sa isang kompetisyon lamang**, maaring [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) o [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ito ay mahigpitang ipinapatupad.

Ang lahat ng kategorya sa dalawang kompetisyon ay magkapareho at binubuo ng isang round lamang. Para sa karagdagang impormasyon sa kompetisyon, maaring i-klik ang mga tabs sa itaas.

Sa pamamagitan ng pagrerehistro, ang mga kalahok at kanilang mga bisita—kabilang ngunit hindi limitado sa mga miyembro ng pamilya, kaibigan, at mga tagapag-alaga—ay kinikilala at sumasang-ayon na ang mga namamahalang katawan, kanilang mga tauhan, at anumang kaugnay na indibidwal ay hindi mananagot para sa anumang pinsala o sakuna, pagkawala ng personal na pag-aari o kagamitan, o emosyonal na pagkabalisa na resulta ng paglahok sa kompetisyon na ito.

Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) bago makilahok sa kompetisyong ito.

***

**PH (Hiligaynon)**
Bugal nga gina-anunsyo Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024**, duha ka kompetisyon nga gina hiwat sa isa ka adlaw—aga kag hapon, para i-selebrar ang maabot nga Masskara Festival sa syudad sang Bacolod.

Hiliwaton ang kompetisyon nga ini sa aga. Ang hapon nga edisyon, makita [diri](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024).

Sa mga maintra, **isa lang dapat ka kompetisyon ang intrahan**, pwede nga [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) ukon [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ini ang strikto nga gina sunod.

Ang tanan nga kategorya sa duha nga kompetisyon parehas lang kag ginalakipan sang isa ka round. Para sa mas madamo pa gid nga impormasyon, palihog i-klik ang mga tabs sa babaw.

Paagi sa pagrehistro, ang mga maintra kag ang ila mga kaupod—lakip na apang indi limitado sa mga miyembro sang pamilya, abyan, kag mga tagabantay—nagasugot kag nagakilala nga ang mga nagadumala, ila mga personnel, kag bisan ano nga may kaangtanan nga mga indibidwal indi manabat para sa bisan ano nga samad o aksidente, pagkadula sang personal nga gamit, ukon emosyonal nga kasakit nga resulta sang pag-apil sa sini nga kompetisyon.

Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) antis mag-intra sa kompetisyon nga ini.

items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu V 2024
items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

[DE] Bitte gebe bei der Anmeldung im Bemerkungsfeld an, ob du ein T-Shirt für die Swiss Nationals kaufen möchtest oder nicht. Wenn du ein T-Shirt kaufen möchtest, gib uns bitte deine grösse an und ob du ein T-Shirt in weiss oder cardinal-rot möchtest. Vor Ort wird es nur eine sehr geringe, limitierte Anzahl T-shirts zu kaufen geben. Die Kosten für das T-Shirt betragen: CHF 25.00. Die kosten sind bei der Registration zu begleichen. Wir müssen die T-Shirts bis zum 08.09.2024 vorbestellen.

[EN] When registering, please indicate in the comments field whether you would like to buy a T-shirt for the Swiss Nationals or not. If you would like to buy a T-shirt, please let us know your size and if you want the T-shirt in white or cardinal-red. There will only be a very small, limited number of T-shirts available for purchase on site. The cost of the T-shirt is: CHF 25.00. You will pay the T-shirt at the registration desk. We must pre-order the T-shirts by 08.09.2024.

[*DE*] Da dies die offizielle Speedcubing Schweizer-Meisterschaft ist, qualifizieren sich die jeweils besten 12 Schweizer der vorherigen Runde sowie alle Teilnehmer anderer Nationalitäten dazwischen für die jeweiligen Finals.

[*EN*] As these are the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, the best 12 Swiss competitors of the previous round as well as all participants of other nationalities in between qualify for the respective finals.

items.name: Championnat Québécois 2024
items.information:
### [FR]

Il s'agit du tout premier championnat québécois organisé par [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org).

13 épreuves officielles de la WCA (toutes les épreuves sauf 4x4x4 à l'aveugle, 5x5x5 à l'aveugle ,3x3x3 Multi-Blind, et 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) seront organisées lors de cette compétition.


**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**.   

### Avis de droit à l'image
Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

---

### [EN]

This is the first-ever Quebec Championship organized by [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org).

13 official WCA events (all events except 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) will be held at this competition.


**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **and do not pay the registration fees**.

### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
##Português

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. 
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**.

Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com

Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor.
Sócios do Clube Aquático da Aclimação terão 50% de desconto na inscrição e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são sócios e comprovar no dia da competição.
Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade.

**Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

##English

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**.

Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com

Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com 
Send the proof with the competitor's name.
Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition.
To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity.

**Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. 

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta.


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2024
items.information:
Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w bardziej popularnych konkurencjach, choć nie zabraknie side'owych akcentów. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/).

Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz ze [Stowarzyszeniem Liga Niezwykłych](https://liganiezwyklych.pl/). Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/) oraz [Mazowsza](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). Marszałek województwa mazowieckiego [Adam Struzik](https://mazovia.pl/pl/bip/zarzad/sklad-zarzadu/adam-struzik.html) objął wydarzenie swoim patronatem.

Na konkurencję **3x3x3 Najmniejsza liczba ruchów** obowiązuje oddzielny limit zawodników: **Najlepsze 30** osób według średniej (lub pojedynczego wyniku) na podstawie zawodników zarejestrowanych.

---

We invite you to the fourth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in the more popular events, though there will be some side events as well. The event will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together.

The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with the Stowarzyszenie Liga Niezwykłych. The event is funded by the City of Warsaw and Mazovia. The Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship, Adam Struzik, has taken the event under his patronage.

For **FMC** event there is a seperate competitor limit: **Top 30** people classified by mean (otherwise single) according to the psych sheet of the registered competitors.

##### Español
​
**¡Bienvenidos a D'Amicis Puebla 2024!**
​
Cierra los ojos e imagina... Un torneo en fechas patrias con puente, en una de las mejores ciudades para dar el grito de independencia, un mix de **9 categorías**, y darte la oportunidad de disfrutar del cierre de temporada de los deliciosos Chiles en Nogada.
​
Puebla, la tierra del Chile en Nogada, te invita a divertirte y disfrutar de este próximo torneo.
​
Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del  **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**.
​
D'Amicis Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​

​
**¡Welcome to D'Amicis Puebla 2024!**
​
Close your eyes and imagine... A tournament on holidays, in one of the best cities to celebrate "El Grito", a mix of **9 categories**, and the chance to enjoy the end of the season for the delicious Chiles en Nogada.
​
Puebla, the land of Chile en Nogada, invites you to have fun and enjoy this upcoming tournament.
​
This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**.
​
D'Amicis Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Gøy på Landet 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.
  
### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoypaLandet2024#46692-forstegangskonkurrenter-first-time-competitors).
 
---
 
## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Gøy på Landet 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.
 
### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoypaLandet2024#46692-forstegangskonkurrenter-first-time-competitors) tab.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

items.name: Qualifying in Kirstenhof 2024
items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This competition is designed as a warmup/rankings qualifier for the [African Championships] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksWCAAfricanChampionship2024) that is coming up in September, so we will have plenty of events and plenty of rounds. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below."
​
## CHANGES TO THE FORMAT
​
We are wanting to maximise the opportunities for all the cubers in our community and as a result we have decided to make the qualifying criteria for second rounds and finals to be much more achievable. Our goal is to have more people competing in more rounds of solving!!
​
### SPECTATORS
​
Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.
​
### VOLUNTEERING
​
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be allocated prior to the event and explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 
​
### LUCKY DRAW
​
During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.
​

items.information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Denver for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations.
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:00 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (6:00 PM MDT 08-17-2024)
This competiton will feature a head-to-head style 3x3 finals!
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de **60** competidores para el registro.

* El precio de la entrada es de $350 para aquellos competidores que compitan en hasta 6 categorías. Para 7 o más categorías, el precio es de $450.
* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English 

Competitor limit: **60**.

* The base entry fee for up to 6 events is $UYU 350. For 7 or more events the entry fee is $UYU 450.
* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46196-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FatimaenMontevideo2024#46197-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: Matatipac Open 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckdEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5052380d4840da25b42fdc99bf608f4ab05e628/Matatipac%20Open%202024%20(1).png)

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al **Matatipac Open 2024**! Esta emocionante y dinámica competencia se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 17 y domingo 18 de agosto de 2024.

El Matatipac Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de rompecabezas tridimensionales, principalmente eventos no cúbicos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

La competencia incluirá una ronda de Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante.

Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.

###### English
Welcome to the **Matatipac Open 2024**! This exciting and dynamic competition will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, August 17, and Sunday, August 18, 2024.

The Matatipac Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of three-dimensional puzzles, primarily non-cubic events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

The competition will include a round of Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting.

Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important for all competitors to be familiar with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information:
After hosting the Canadian Championship in July 2023, Speedcubing Canada welcomes you back for BC's first Provincial Championship!

Note: While everybody is welcome to attend and compete, only BC residents will be eligible for the title of **BC Champion**. For more information, please check out the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2024#41375-championship-eligibility).

**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. So, if you are not competing in any events being held on Friday, then you don't need to show up until Saturday. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

### Staffing
Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info.

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

### Staffing
We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

##Português:

**Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**.
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Caso o limite de 50 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$30, por ordem de chegada.

##English:

**Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**.
In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

If the competitor limit of 50 has not been reached, we'll be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$30, in order of arrival.

## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.


## NOTICE OF FILMING:

Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## VENUE

Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. 
The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options.
On Sunday they also serve a separate Buffet Lunch which you are more than welcome to take part in.
Bathroom facilities are available inside the venue, and the Centre itself also provides alternative bathrooms outside of the venue itself.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

**Español**
**¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!**

La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad.

Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. 

¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

**Inglés**
**Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!**

Guelaguetza is much more than just a festival; it's the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that characterize this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community.

And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik's Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we're not only showcasing skill and dexterity but also the ability to come together in a common challenge, regardless of our background or culture.

Don't miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where Rubik's Cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We look forward to seeing you at "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng.
Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab.

# Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5

Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau:
* Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công.
* Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng.
Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp).
# Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________
We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds.
Refer to the tabs for more information.

# Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded
Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria:
* The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result.
* The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event.

items.information:
本大会は七夕伝説の残る大阪府交野市で行われる大会です。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**同伴申請は、競技参加者１名につき１名**に制限しています。
**競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴は受け付けておりません。**
また、同伴希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先とし、
会場の許容人数を超える方に関しては会場前ロビーにて待機をお願いする場合があります。
なお、見学者は原則として受け入れませんが、会場内人数に余裕がある場合はこの限りではありません。

本大会は受付を午前と午後の2回実施します。出場される種目に合わせご都合の良い受付に合わせてお越しください。

本大会は固定の昼休みの時間を設けません。休憩は各自でお取りください。


This competition is held in Katano City, Osaka Pref.

**Only one companion per competitor is allowed to be at the venue as a spectator.**
If the number of people at the venue is too many,  Guardians for minors would be prioritized.
In principle, no visitor will be accepted.

There will be two registration times for this competition, one in the morning and the other in the afternoon. Please come to the registration desk that is most convenient for your event.

There will be no fixed lunch time at this competition. Please take breaks on your own.

items.name: 24 Hours in Åker 2024
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! 

Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken [koncept](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept).

-----

A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! 

Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept).

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

##### Español

**¡Bienvenidos a Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!**

Puebla, la ciudad donde la grandeza se encuentra entre volcanes, se está preparando para recibirte en un próximo torneo y poner a prueba tus habilidades. ¿Qué tan fuerte podrás llegar? ¡Esto es un reto contra ti mismo!

*¿Sabías que...?*
El triángulo se considera la figura geométrica más fuerte.
Cuando piensas en los volcanes, ¿qué categoría viene a tu mente?
Así es como Pyraminx representa diferentes aspectos de este torneo. 

Estamos seguros que no esperabas tremendas referencias con el nombre, el lugar y nuestra categoría principal. Y aún hay más, ¡échale un vistazo a los detalles y verás la fusión!

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de  **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

##### English

**¡Welcome to Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!**

Puebla, the city where greatness lies among volcanoes, is gearing up to welcome you to an upcoming competition and test your skills. How strong will you be able to become? This is a challenge against yourself!

*Did you know...?*
That triangle is considered the strongest geometric shape.
When thinking about volcanoes, which is the category that comes to your mind? 
This is how Pyraminx represents different aspects of this competition.

We're sure you weren't expecting such remarkable references between the name, location and our main event. And there's still more, take a look at the details and you'll see the fusion!

This competition is possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**.

Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png)

*  This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk!
*  The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon!
*  The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png)

*  Una Nuummi Speedcubing-imik unamminerup aappassaraa World Cube Association-imiit akuerisaq!
*  Unammineq sapaammi 23. juni ualikkut nal. 13:10-19:45 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq arfiningornermi 22. juni nal. 16:00 19:00 aamma sapaammi 23. juni nal. 12-13 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut  sapaammi.
*  Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terningip naammassisinnaanngornissaa.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png)

*  Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk!
*  Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv søndag eftermiddag.
*  Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2024!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. 

If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44503-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44504-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English

* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και OH ή Pyraminx και Skewb επιθυμείτε.

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Friends 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.
 
### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.
 
### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).
 
---
 
## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Friends 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.
 
### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.
 
### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.name: Ilulissat 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png)

*  This is the first speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Ilulissat!
*  The competition happens on Saturday 15 June in the afternoon (13 to 16), but a workshop will happen the morning (9 ti 12) and the day before, Friday 14 from 13 to 17. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Saturday afternoon!
*  The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png)

* Una Ilulissani speedcubingimik unammisitsineq siullerpaajuvoq World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaq!
*  Unammineq arfininngornermi 15. juni ualikkut nal. 13:00-16:00 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq tallimanngornermi 14. juni nal. 13:00-17:00 aamma arfininngornermi 15. juni nal. 09:00-12:00 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Arfininngornermi ualikkut periutsinik nutaanik ilinniarnissannut nuannersumut peqatigisigut Cube-ertartut allat peqatigalugit, imminullu time-lersornermut piareersarlutit.
*  Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit aggeqqutissaatit piffissalersussallutillu, angusanni pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu ilanngaatigeriarlugit sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnerat unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissinneqarumaarpoq. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terning-ip naammassisinnaanngornissaa, tamanna pillugu pikkorissanermi ikiorumaarpatsigit.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png)

*  Dette er den første speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i ilulissat!
*  Konkurrencen finder sted lørdag den 15. juni om eftermiddagen kl. 13:00-16:00, før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop fredag den 14. fra kl. 13:00-17:00 og lørdag fra kl. 09:00-12:00. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv lørdag eftermiddag.
*  Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

​
​
Registration fee: R$ 50,00
**As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.**
Competitor limit: 40
​
​
REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita:
​
Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo.
​
Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. 
Há um limite de 40 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com).
​
Para os competidores menores de idade que forem ficar desacompanhados durante o período da noite, será necessário o envio de uma autorização de um pai ou responsável autorizando a permanência após este horário.

Esta é uma competição de 24 horas e portanto atente-se a isso. Caso não possa ficar as 24 horas, não há necessidade, preze pela sua saúde e bem-estar mental.

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted:
​
Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below;
​
Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. 
There will be a limit of 40 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com)

To underage competitors that will stay alone during the night period, it will be requested an express authorization of a parent or guardian authorizing the competitor's participation during said period.

This is a 24 hour competition, therefore, be attentive to that. In case you're not able to stay the 24 hours, there is no need to, value your health and mental well-being.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Summer 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Summer 2024 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.
